newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: OB Brewery absorption plan to be approved.
newsitem.headline: OB Brewery absorption plan to be approved.

text.p: OB Brewery Co's plan to absorb its affiliate Doosan Beverage Co is expected to be approved at the shareholder meetings of the two firms on Friday, the Korea Securities Depository said on Thursday.
A depository statement said the absorption plan had been opposed by shareholders owning 1.48 percent of OB shares and those holding 8.75 percent of Doosan shares.

OB plans to absorb Doosan at a ratio of 100 for every 153.7 Doosan shares for the common stock and 100 for every 285.5 shares for the preferred stock. Shareholders opposing the absorption may offer to sell their shares to the two firms within 20 days after shareholders approve the plan, the statement said.
OB earlier proposed accepting offers at 26,874 won per common share and 6,741 won per preferred share, against their market prices of 32,400 won and 7,100 won on Thursday.
Doosan proposed to accept offers at 34,914 won per common share and 10,234 won per preferred share, against their market prices of 34,400 won and 9,200 won on Thursday.
